LEAK_DEFINITIONS.L0: embargo off (g=0) and no purge; literature-known reference leak
LEAK_DEFINITIONS.L1: whole-series normalisation: T/I/F, V-signed and imputation from the full series (v1 feature path)
LEAK_DEFINITIONS.L2: self-predictive proxy: target index at the most recent day, no model
LEAK_DEFINITIONS.L3: in-sample weight selection: no pathway into RF-on-[T,I,F] (lambda never enters features) -- inert
LEAK_DEFINITIONS.L4: target index built with tuned lambda* instead of fixed (0.2,0.3,0.5)

EXPLORATORY: target-swap shift: (delta on self-derived target) - (delta on raw-feature target), four comparisons, mean, BCa 95% CI, Wilcoxon P, BH q
DATA_ROWS: one row per local calendar date, built from the Fitbit daily files; wellness is never merged into days_df; dates asserted unique and consecutive for every participant (cell D-2)
P12_DECISION: max heart rate read with pd.to_numeric(errors='coerce') (cell held a single space; max HR is not a model feature). p12 enters only through the existing rules (>= 15 rows, >= 10 scored test folds). If it enters, the primary numbers are also reported without p12, with p12 removed from the cohort and from every donor pool

WELLNESS_RULES.W1: date each report by its local calendar day (Europe/Oslo), from the tz-aware timestamp
WELLNESS_RULES.W2: for the five items scored 1-5, 0 = missing; readiness runs 0-10, so 0 is valid there
WELLNESS_RULES.W3: a report whose five 1-5 items are all 0 is a blank submission: drop the whole report, before W4
WELLNESS_RULES.W4: several reports on one local day: keep the last valid report of that day, item by item after W2; no valid value for an item that day -> missing

WELLNESS_USE: separate per-participant table, one row per local date (cell W-1); joined only when the Task 3 target is built; not used in Tasks 1-2
